universe: Every FDACS press release from 2023-01-03 to 2024-12-31 (166 releases, www.fdacs.gov year indexes; raw/fdacs-releases-2023-2024.json) read for actions of the department that name a private party. Department-only RFLPP easement purchases (under $5 million, no Cabinet vote since HB 1279, 2023) are the Commissioner's own office actions. RFLPP easements the Cabinet approved are in cabinet-bot/actions.json, not here. Contracts, grants and purchase orders from FACTS are not included (needs-browser.md 3d-3f).
